items.name: tour-frame
items.title: TourFrame
items.description: Frame of the modal guide runs: step content, counter and Skip / Previous / Next / Finish, with CSS entry animations driven by data-side.

items.name: guide-spotlight
items.title: GuideSpotlight
items.description: Veil of the modal guide run with one hole per target; clicking it dismisses the run when it is dismissible.

items.name: hint
items.title: Hint
items.description: Frame of the passive guide runs: a pulsing beacon on the target that opens the step's content in a popover, with Next / Got it and a close button.

items.name: welcome-dialog
items.title: WelcomeDialog
items.description: Alert dialog that proposes a guide once the records are hydrated: Start, or Resume / Start over for an in-progress one, and Skip.

items.name: next-router-adapter
items.title: nextRouterAdapter
items.description: Connects the guide manager to the Next.js App Router (router.push and usePathname).
